tools.name: search
tools.description: Search National Digital's published pages - services, articles, case studies and pricing - for a topic or keyword. Returns up to 10 ranked results, each with an id, title, url, type and a short excerpt. Pass a result's id to fetch for the page's full text.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read one published National Digital page as clean Markdown, given an id from search (the page's site path, e.g. /platform-engineering/) or its full URL. Returns the page's text with its title, canonical url and last-modified date. Long pages are returned in parts; pass the returned nextOffset as off

tools.name: get_pricing_and_services
tools.description: What National Digital builds and supports, and what each kind of project typically costs, in AUD. Includes the Product Support retainer for ongoing engineering on production platforms, including platforms built by other teams. Ranges are indicative and come from delivered work; they are not quotes.

tools.name: estimate_project
tools.description: Estimate the cost range for a specific software project. Uses the same calculation as the estimator on the website, so the answer matches what a person would be shown.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Send an enquiry to National Digital on behalf of the person you are helping. Only use this when they have asked you to make contact. A human replies within one business day.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: submit_enquiry · Public sink: submit_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch · Private data: submit_enquiry · Public sink: submit_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
